description: Use this when someone asks about a mining company's PEA, pre-feasibility or feasibility study: its NPV, IRR, capex, AISC, mine life, production or price assumptions. Give it the company's ticker or name. Returns the company's studies newest first, each with its type, date, project, whether the technical report is filed, the study's price deck, every headline figure copied as the release printed it with its basis (after-tax or pre-tax) and discount rate, the study's own price sensitivity table, its qualified persons and the 6ix.com link to the release.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

name: get_company_studies

caution.description: NI 43-101's PEA cautionary statement, when the PEA uses Inferred resources; quote it with the figures

field.description: npv, irr, payback, initialCapex, sustainingCapex, aisc, cashCost, mineLife, production, throughput, recovery, stripRatio, headGrade or fcf

period.description: The period the figure covers, as printed (life of mine, years 1–5…)

rate.description: The NPV's discount rate as printed

result.description: The figure in words, e.g. NPV C$1,856M (after-tax, 5%)

unit.description: Its unit as printed (C$M, %, US$/oz, years…)

latest.description: The newest study 6ix lists for this project

prices.description: The study's own price deck, as printed

project.description: The project as the company names it

qps.description: The qualified persons the release names

anyOf.description: The study's own price sensitivity table, row by row as printed; 6ix works out nothing between rows

stage.description: Announced (results released, report to follow) or Technical report filed

title: Mine studies from a company
